headline: Sonam Wangchuk breaks 26-day fast in Gurgaon
summary: The Ladakhi activist ended his hunger strike after discussions on specific conditions and concerns over potential violence in the country.
details: Ladakh rights activist Sonam Wangchuk ended his 26-day hunger strike late Thursday night at Medanta Hospital in Gurgaon.
caption:
After 26 days without food, Ladakhi activist Sonam Wangchuk has ended his hunger strike.

Ladakh rights activist Sonam Wangchuk ended his 26-day hunger strike late Thursday night at Medanta Hospital in Gurgaon.

headline: AI and nationalization: Demand for unskilled labor shrinking in Middle East
summary: Automation and 'nationalization' policies in Gulf countries are threatening the traditional model of labor export for Bangladesh, risking future remittances.
details: For decades, Middle Eastern countries have been a primary source of employment and remittances for Bangladesh, fueling both rural economies and national growth.
caption:
The era of unskilled labor export is ending. AI and nationalization policies in the Middle East are threatening the very foundation of Bangladesh's remittance economy.

For decades, Middle Eastern countries have been a primary source of employment and remittances for Bangladesh, fueling both rural economies and national growth.

#Bangladesh #MiddleEast #Remittance #Economy #AI #LaborMarket
